name: KB wall clip: a full-tilt tap toward the wall at the jump's apex
techNote: A 400-tall Ground wall (x -50-50) on a floor, the finish on its top; a floor jump peaks at 300. Jump with your back to the wall (back edge 2 u from it), let go of jump near the apex, and with Velocity.y under 200 press jump with the stick full toward the wall for one tick: the turn swings the hitbox 10 u into the wall, the next tick's front ground ray starts inside it and grounds the dot, and the buffered jump is a full ground jump from there. Turning back at full tilt leaves the back edge ~8.3 u out, past the 8 u a second clip needs. Hold toward the wall over its top.
